title: Definition of ‘State’ under Article 12
subject: Polity
caption: Components comprising ‘State’ under Article 12
altText: A mind‑map diagram with ‘State’ at the centre. Branches extend to Union Government (showing President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers), Parliament (Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha), State Governments & Legislatures (Governor, Chief Minister, State Legislature with Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council), and Local Authorities (Municipalities, Panchayats, Zila Parishad).
